description: Cross-model social-intelligence benchmark scores collected from benchmark papers / official leaderboards (web only, numbers read directly from tables). See each score's source/source_model_string. Canonical names follow e.g. 'GPT-4o','Qwen2.5-VL-7B'. Duplicate API versions kept as separate rows when the source distinguishes them.

EgoNormia.table: Table 5 (appendix full results; superset of Table 1, identical values for shared rows)
EgoNormia.metric: % correct MCQ, 'Both' (action+justification) accuracy, Video Models setting, Full split n=1853

EgoNormia_verified.metric: % correct MCQ 'Both', Video Models setting, EgoNormia-verified split n=200

EgoNormia_pipeline.metric: % correct MCQ 'Both', Pipeline setting (model reasons over text description of video), Full split

SIV-Bench.url: https://kfq20.github.io/sivbench/ (project page 'Main Results'; same numbers as arXiv 2506.05425v3 SIV-Bench-Hard appendix table 'Acc (Origin)')
SIV-Bench.table: Main Results table (arXiv HTML renders main table as image)
SIV-Bench.metric: Overall accuracy %, 'orig' condition (video with original audio), 5,455-QA version

SIV-Bench_SSR.metric: Social State Reasoning (SSR: emotion/intent/attitude/relation) accuracy %, orig condition

EmoBench-M.metric: Avg. of FER/CEU/SCEA dimension scores (mean ACC per dimension; LR total score in SCEA)

EmoBench-M_SCEA.metric: Socially Complex Emotion Analysis (humor, sarcasm, laughter reasoning) dimension score

SoMi-ToM_first.metric: First-person state-inference ToM, weighted average accuracy %, w/o CoT

SoMi-ToM_third.metric: Third-person ToM (goal + behavior inference), average accuracy %, 175 Qs, w/o CoT

MuMA-ToM.metric: Accuracy % on all questions (belief, social goal, belief of goal), video+text
MuMA-ToM.chance: 33.3 (3-way MCQ per question; not stated in table, check paper)

MuMA-ToM_AutoToM.metric: Accuracy % on MuMA-ToM as evaluated by AutoToM authors (LLM baselines)

MMToM-QA_AutoToM.metric: Accuracy % on MMToM-QA, LLM baseline as evaluated by AutoToM authors

ToMBench.metric: Task-oriented ToM accuracy %, AVG over 8 tasks, English, vanilla prompting (no CoT)
ToMBench.chance: varies by task (2-4 options); not reported as single number

SimpleToM.metric: Average accuracy % over mental-state, behavior-prediction, judgment questions

SocialIQA.url: see per-score source (Llama 2 Table 20, Llama 3 Herd Table 11, Gemma 3 Table 9, Gemma Table 6)
SocialIQA.metric: SIQA 0-shot accuracy, PRE-TRAINED base models, log-likelihood scoring

HumanVBench_Emotion.metric: Emotion Perception avg of 4 tasks (ER, ETA, AR, EIC), accuracy %

HumanVBench_Behavior.metric: Behavior Analysis avg of 4 tasks, accuracy %

MMBench_SocialRelation.metric: Accuracy % (VLMEvalKit, CircularEval), single image; ~90 items so ~1.1pt granularity, strong ceiling effect
MMBench_SocialRelation.chance: ~25 under CircularEval chance is lower than 1/k

MMT-Bench_SocialRelation.metric: Accuracy % (VLMEvalKit); only ~20 items (5-pt steps) -> very noisy
